notes.title: First Update and Item Drops!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

Following features were rolled out in this patch:

1. Zoom in / out on the board

2. Space key option for dart throwing

3. Leaderboards

4. Achievements

5. Item Drops: 4 items - Common, Uncommon, Rare and Epic 

6. Hopefuly I killed more bugs than added.

Thanks for playing and have a great day!

ANPAUS
